pages.text: This focus is not for blasting. It is for $(l:goety:goetyarcana/void_creeper_servant)hiring$(). Each cast drags three Void Creeper Servants out of the void; wear a $(l:crafts/garment/void_robe)Void Robe$() and it becomes six.

Cast with a $(l:crafts/staff/void_staff)Void Staff$() and each servant has a three-in-ten chance to come out of the void enchanted. They look much the same - only the runes burn brighter, and the blast is far less forgiving.
